snippet.title: The Comeback King trailer June 2026
snippet.description:
"He might be down - but he's not out!"

In The Comeback King, you're the manager of a faded fighter battling to win his first championship title. Releases on Steam Q3 2026.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833230/The_Comeback_King/

Original soundtrack on Spotify: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3833230/The_Comeback_King/ (also on Apple Music, Amazon Music, Deezer, etc.)

Original soundtrack on vinyl LP: https://elasticstage.com/soundcloud/releases/television-of-cruelty-the-comeback-king-original-soundtrack-album
